[EN] Ever seen argons? I never did. However, I heard about them from soldiers on leave. Whenever they heard the word "argon," their face darkened.
[ES] ¿Alguna vez has visto argons? Yo nunca. Sin embargo, escuché sobre ellos de los soldados de permiso. Cada vez que escuchaban la palabra "argon", su rostro se oscurecía.

[EN] Whew... I can't give up!
[ES] Uf... ¡no puedo rendirme!
